0022600137.text: The Bulls (1-3) host the Knicks (1-3) in the 5th game of Chicago's season, with both teams two games back in their divisions and the Bulls on a two-game losing streak while New York has won its last game. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), while Patrick Williams (groin soreness) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and New York is without Jose Alvarado (out, ankle sprain). There are no 2026-27 meetings yet, and in 2025-26 the Bulls lost the season series 1-3, including a 136-96 loss in New York on April 3.
